subject_rule: The General scheme (Atal Bihari Vajpayee) takes any field at the empanelled institutions except medical and para-medical courses, law, fashion, integrated courses, and IIT B.Tech; certificates and diplomas only in Indian languages and literature, performing or visual arts and yoga. Narrower schemes: Quad STEM (4-year bachelor engineering at 8 named institutions), Lata Mangeshkar (Indian culture fields plus a yoga diploma), and the AYUSH scheme (Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, Homoeopathy and Yoga courses, which are open there even though other medical courses are not).
